description: React to one message in a thread with an emoji, or remove: true to take the reaction back. Pass the thread_id and message_id from message_thread. Costs $0.005 per action. Requires a connected account. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

account_id.description: Which connected account (accounts_list). Optional while this key has exactly one.

thread_id.description: The thread id from messages_list or message_thread.

name: message_react
title: React to a Message
